summary: Incomplete prefetch lease mismatch causing persistent pipeline sag in dedicated pool
description:
Issue summary:
CipherNova reported sustained p50/p95 throughput decline (~15-30% below baseline) on their dedicated pool beginning 2026-03-10 09:10 UTC. Symptoms matched a steady reduction in batched pipeline utilization with occasional short-lived recoveries. Impact affected two pinned models used by their conversational product and resulted in customer-reported slowdowns and higher queueing.

Impact:
- Customer-facing latency increase: p50 +160ms, p95 +600ms vs baseline for steady low-latency routes.
- Effective QPS drop of 18% on pinned dedicated pool during peak window.
- No token loss, but degraded throughput triggered customer throttling thresholds.

Environment:
- Dedicated pool (reserved), us-east-1, GPU type: A100-80GB mix.
- Autoscaler config: proactive with cooldown 90s, predictive disabled.
- KV/prefix caching enabled for both models.

Steps to reproduce (environment sensitive):
1) Run steady batched traffic to gptx-13b-8k with 8 concurrent clients at 200 RPS total from us-east-1.
2) Observe per-GPU pipeline utilization and batch fill rates.
3) Notice a gradual decline in batch fill and sustained single-digit drop in active pipeline streaks after ~20 minutes.

Observed logs / metrics (excerpts):
- scheduler: "lease:prefetch_incomplete=0.23, failed_handoff=12/1h"
- serving-runtime: "pipeline_streaks=0.68 -> 0.51 (20m)"
- autoscaler: "scale_decision:hold due to transient attach-failures"
- NVLink errors: none; driver stable.

Initial hypothesis:
We suspect a race between prefetch lease heartbeats and scheduler handoff when GPUs are under heterogeneous attachment churn. Some prefetch leases appear to be marked incomplete, leaving partial batches or orphaned prefetch slots that reduce effective pipeline saturation. This behaves like a noisy-neighbor but at the lease/handshake layer rather than pure compute hogging.

Customer impact and requested outcome:
Customer requests restoration of baseline throughput and mitigation so similar lease mismatches do not recur. They requested visibility into handoff failures and a short-term workaround if available.
steps_to_reproduce: Generate steady RPS to pinned models from us-east-1
Measure batch fill and pipeline streak over 30 minutes
Correlate scheduler lease logs with serving-runtime pipeline metrics
comments: 2026-03-10 09:30 UTC - Support (Ava Martinez): Ticket created after CipherNova alert. Customer provided flame graphs and pprof for a single worker.
2026-03-10 10:05 UTC - SRE (Ravi Kapoor): Collected scheduler and runtime traces. Observed increased prefetch_incomplete counters on several GPUs. Opening instrumented trace request to runtime team.
2026-03-10 13:20 UTC - Runtime Eng (Leah Chen): Confirmed mismatched lease timestamps between prefetcher and executor on 3/12 GPUs. Suspect negotiated timeout value not honored on some attach paths.

2026-03-11 02:10 UTC - SRE (Ravi Kapoor): Deployed temporary autotuner config to shorten prefetch handshake TTL to 5s for affected pool; observed partial recovery (~8% improvement) but not full baseline.
2026-03-11 14:00 UTC - Support (Ava Martinez): Customer reports throughput improved but intermittent slowdowns persist during midday spike. Requested full root cause and permanent fix timeline.
investigation_notes: Prefetch_incomplete metric rose from baseline 0.02 to 0.23 during incident window.
Trace correlation shows lease author (scheduler-node-17) issued prefetch requests that never reached 'complete' state before executor moved to next batch on 3 GPUs.
Attached GPUs show no driver errors; CPU-side handshake delays of 40-120ms observed on kubelet attach path.
Autoscaler held scaling decisions due to perceived attach failures (false-positive) — this prevented adding capacity to mask the issue.
resolution_notes: Short-term remediation: reduced prefetch handshake TTL and tuned scheduler retry backoff. Applied to pool at 2026-03-11 02:00 UTC. Observed partial throughput recovery.

Medium-term fix: runtime team to land commit that tightens lease state transitions and adds a reconciliation worker to sweep 'prefetch_incomplete' leases older than 10s. PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4128 (testing in staging).

Follow-ups: add dashboard alert for prefetch_incomplete > 0.1 and an autoscaler exception when attach error rate is correlated with incomplete leases. Schedule postmortem runbook update and communicate to CipherNova by 2026-03-14.
Customer workaround: temporarily enable conservative burst_capacity for their dedicated pool to absorb intermittent drops until permanent fix is deployed.
public_notes: Customer-facing summary will be drafted after root cause verification. Initial message: we identified a prefetch lease mismatch causing partial pipeline starvation; a temporary config change restored some throughput and a targeted fix is in testing.
internal_priority_notes: Treat as Sev1 due to dedicated customer impact and SLA exposure. Coordinating runtime, scheduler, and autoscaler teams.
